torii_color.name: 朱色 shu-iro (vermilion)
torii_color.note: nominal traditional-colour value for 朱色, not a measured paint sample; on vermilion torii black is limited to the top beam (kasagi) and the post bases (nemaki)

torii_count.v: about 10,000 torii in all; roughly 800 form the Senbon Torii

torii_sizes.sizes_offered: 5号 to 10号 (5号 = 15 cm posts per cocolocala; 10号 ~30 cm is inferred assuming the number is the post diameter in sun, ~3 cm each)
torii_sizes.gate_width_m: mapped torii widths in OSM: 1.2-5 m on the trail, 11-11.5 m for the two great approach torii
torii_sizes.height_m: about 2-3.5 m on the trail (estimate; only unsourced 3.5 m found); tunnel path is 2 m wide (OSM width tag)
torii_sizes.spacing_m: Senbon Torii tunnels: see torii_paths[0..1] density (spacing = 1/density); measured from OSM note counts

torii_donated.v: Every torii is donated by an individual or company; the donor's name and the date are written in black on the back of each gate. Donating torii began in the Edo period.

hike_time.v: about 2-3 hours to the summit and back (full loop, incl. ~30 min for the loop at the top); ~1.5-2 h to Yotsutsuji and back

crowds.v: crowds thin out past the first gates: "the higher we climb, the less there are hikers"; "twenty minutes past the tunnel, most of the crowd is simply gone"

hours_fee.v: always open (24 hours, no closing days); entry is free

foxes.v: Fox (kitsune) statues are Inari's messengers; they hold a key (to the rice granary) or a jewel in their mouths, also sheaves of rice or scrolls

omokaru_ishi.v: Pair of stone lanterns at the back right of Okusha Hohaisho: make a wish and lift the top stone; lighter than expected = wish comes true

romon.v: Romon (tower gate) said to have been built by Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1589

mountain.v: Mt. Inari (Inariyama) is 233 m, the southernmost of the 36 Higashiyama peaks; trails ~4 km
